messages.subject: Raw data "HapMap270,6.0,CEU,testSet." used in CRMA v2 method
parts:
Dear aroma developer,


I met a problem with the raw data:HapMap270,6.0,CEU,testSet. I could not find the raw data on the website.
- Hide quoted text -

Here's the path that I looked for the data:
Support > Microarray Technical Documentations > Library Files> DNA Analysis Arrays > Genome-Wide Human SNP Array 6.0 (zip, 246 MB) which is located at http://www.affymetrix.com/Auth/support/downloads/library_files/genomewidesnp6_libraryfile.zip

The files-- "NA06985.CEL, NA06991.CEL, NA06993.CEL, NA06994.CEL, NA07000.CEL, NA07019.CEL" are not there. Also I tried to install the exe file on windows hoping it could extract some files, but it gave me error said could not find some txt.
I dont know have you met this? I just need to find the sample raw data.

Thank you!


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Raw data

rawData/
   HapMap270,6.0,CEU,testSet/
     GenomeWideSNP_6/
        NA06985.CEL, NA06991.CEL, NA06993.CEL, NA06994.CEL, NA07000.CEL, NA07019.CEL
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
Best regards,
Yu Song

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Raw data "HapMap270,6.0,CEU,testSet." used in CRMA v2 method
parts:
Hi,

originally those data files were only available on a DVD that you had
to order from Affymetrix, whereas now you'll find *similar* data files
from the the HapMap Project itself. AFAIK, we are not allowed to
redistribute. Even if you cannot find the exact same samples at
HapMap, you can use any GWS6 CEL files in the vignette. You'll find
more details and links via:

http://www.aroma-project.org/datasets/Affymetrix/

which you can also reach by following the link 'Data Sets' in "These
GenomeWideSNP_6 CEL files are available from Affymetrix part of a
larger HapMap data set, cf. online Page 'Data Sets'." on
http://www.aroma-project.org/vignettes/CRMAv2/

/Henrik
